name: Zosuchus
isnote: PBDB places it in a shartegosuchid/shartegosuchoid group that has no clade entry in the atlas yet; placed in the nearest atlas ancestor.
sum: Zosuchus is a basal crocodyliform from the Late Cretaceous Djadokhta Formation (Zos Canyon) of Mongolia.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: Remains from the Redbeds of Zos Canyon, Gobi Desert.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Pol and Norell 2004

sources.text: D. Pol and M. A. Norell. 2004. A New Crocodyliform from Zos Canyon, Mongolia. American Museum Novitates 3445:1-36
